fix(fingerprint): keep valid fingerprints for tracks shorter than 120s (#136)

* fix(fingerprint): keep valid fingerprints for tracks shorter than 120s

`fpcalc -length 120` reads to EOF on any track shorter than the fingerprint
window and exits non-zero with "Error decoding audio frame (End of file)" -
but it still writes a valid FINGERPRINT= line to stdout first. `_run_fpcalc`
raised CalledProcessError on any non-zero exit, discarding those fingerprints,
so every sub-120s file silently failed Tier-3 (AcoustID) identification and
fell through to tag/manual-review matching. Game soundtracks and interludes,
which are full of short cues, were hit hardest.

Only treat a non-zero fpcalc exit as a failure when no fingerprint was
produced; otherwise use the fingerprint it emitted. Also corrects the
_FPCALC_LENGTH comment, which wrongly claimed `-length` needs no special
handling for short files.

Repro: `fpcalc -length 120 <file-under-120s>` prints a fingerprint and exits 3;
`fpcalc -length 100` on the same file exits 0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(conversion): pin live stat/tag revisions in edition previews (#427)

The preview plan item pinned the source file's SHA-256 into the expected stat and tag revisions, but the freshness check compares those against the local_tracks row's size:mtime stat revision and tag digest, so every kept conversion preview read as FILE_CHANGED and could never be applied. fix(musicbrainz): follow bounded same-origin BrainzMash redirects (#426)

Merged MusicBrainz entities answer a lookup with a 301 to the surviving entity, and BrainzMash mirrors that. The BrainzMash client disables redirects, so those lookups failed permanently. Each hop is now a separate scheduler slot with its own limiter admission and dispatch check, the Location is resolved against the approved origin and revalidated before dialing, the hop count is bounded, and other clients are unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Jules <git-bot@lucidbox.ca>

fix(library): ignore missing catalog rows in destination collisions (#416)

fix(library): return authoritative tracklists and repair stale aliases (#419)

The album tracks endpoint returned the local inventory as the expected tracklist whenever rows existed, so a partial album could read as complete and Wanted could stop early; it now always resolves the authoritative release tracklist and lets provider failures raise. A legacy release-group alias with no visible rows no longer masks the single active owner of that provider identity, while ambiguous editions stay album-scoped.

fix(wanted): skip dispatch when the watch stops during scouting (#420)

The sweep's due row is only a snapshot, so a stop committed while a slow scout was running could still start a download afterwards. Re-read the watch immediately before the first mutating action and skip when it is gone or no longer watching. This closes the post-scout window only; atomic cancellation of a dispatch in flight remains separate work.
